extra.reason: Resolved inside bead .10's fix pass: logOpenFailed(reason:) now takes the closed OpenFailureReason enum (no associated String, no ExpressibleByStringLiteral), so a secret cannot syntactically reach the log. Verified by the .10 reviewer, who could not route a secret through any public EventLog API.

All four review defects fixed and independently verified. EventLog is instantiated and recording (self-test proves real entries); the Settings log view renders with a working NSPasteboard Copy; the Int-boundary trap is fixed via Int(exactly:) with a test proven to crash against the old guard; the Retry action is wired via a delegate assigned strictly after the bundle-identifier guard, so the launch-crash fix is not regressed. 103 tests pass, zero warnings, SELFTEST PASS. Known scope gap (coarse open events only) filed separately as gateopener-4ub.21.

Reviewed FAIL then fixed and re-verified by the orchestrator. All done-criteria met: idempotent build-app.sh, correct Info.plist (LSUIElement=true, ie.boboco.GateOpener, macOS 14 floor), valid ad-hoc signature under --verify --deep --strict, no Dock icon (lsappinfo type=UIElement), reproducible icon (byte-identical .icns on regeneration, generator degrades gracefully without librsvg), README build/install section, artifacts gitignored, zero secrets. CRITICAL: the bundled app leaves both real UserDefaults domains absent — the first true test of bead .17's fix. The one blocking defect (kSMErrorLaunchDeniedByUser = 11, not 1) is fixed and verified against the SDK header, now matched with its error domain to avoid false positives. Test-coverage gap that allowed it filed as gateopener-4ub.22.

PERFORMED LIVE BY THE OPERATOR 2026-08-27. They launched the app, signed in with real credentials (authentication succeeded), discovery selected the gate, and clicking the Test button OPENED THE REAL PHYSICAL GATE. That validates the whole stack end to end: OAuth2+PKCE login, keychain storage, endpoint discovery with the Generic Actuator correctly excluded, percent-encoded endpoint id, and the open command. Remaining visual/behavioural checks that were never verifiable headlessly are carried into gateopener-iif.5 (operator smoke test), and Launch-at-Login verification into gateopener-iif.4 — both re-run against the /Applications install rather than the build directory.
